Title: Back office sign-in is recorded as a successful Password attempt

Title: Over-length values are truncated without losing the rest of the batch
Preconditions: Sign-in log available on {{BACK_URL}} (Security > Sign-in log); recording enabled (Settings > Platform > Sign In Log > Record sign-in attempts = On)
Steps:
[HTTP] send a sign-in attempt with a user-agent header well over the stored length
[HTTP] send a sign-in attempt with a user name well over the stored length
[ACT] perform one ordinary attempt in the same window
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/sign-in-log/search until the expected row appears, up to 90s (the writer is buffered — a single immediate read is not evidence of absence)
Cross_Layer_Checks: [API] the total count grows by the number of attempts made
Failure_Signals: the whole batch lost because of one over-length value; a write that throws instead of truncating

Title: No password value ever reaches the log
Preconditions: Sign-in log available on {{BACK_URL}} (Security > Sign-in log); recording enabled (Settings > Platform > Sign In Log > Record sign-in attempts = On); attempts with both correct and wrong passwords exist
Steps:
[HTTP] search over a window covering successful and failed attempts, take a large page
[ACT] scan every field of every returned record for the password values used
Assertions:
[BODY] no field of any record contains a password, in any form {SPEC}
[BODY] this holds for failed attempts as well, where the wrong password was supplied by the caller {SPEC}
Cross_Layer_Checks: [API] the audit surface is readable by anyone holding the read permission, so a leaked secret here would be a disclosure
Failure_Signals: a password appearing in any column, including free-text ones

Title: Deleting a user keeps their audit records
Preconditions: Sign-in log available on {{BACK_URL}} (Security > Sign-in log); recording enabled (Settings > Platform > Sign In Log > Record sign-in attempts = On)
Steps:
[HTTP] POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users/create for AGENT-TEST-sil062-deleted@example.com
[WAIT] the account to be created
[ACT] sign in once successfully as that account
[ACT] sign in once with a wrong password for the same account
[WAIT] poll POST {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/sign-in-log/search until the expected row appears, up to 90s (the writer is buffered — a single immediate read is not evidence of absence)
[HTTP] DELETE {{BACK_URL}}/api/platform/security/users?names=<throwaway user name>
[HTTP] search by keyword on the throwaway user name
Cross_Layer_Checks: [API] an audit trail that disappears with the account it describes is not an audit trail
Failure_Signals: records deleted together with the account; userId cleared on the surviving rows
Cleanup: none — the account is deleted by the test itself
